experiment_card_checks.endpoint_interpretation: Unconfirmed, investigator-assessed phase 1 ORR in dose-specific response-evaluable groups; no randomized concurrent comparator.

Patent-reported preliminary human PK may inform an exposure hypothesis. It does not establish exposure-response, comparative efficacy, current phase3 dosing, a safety margin, primary PFS benefit, a clinical success probability or incremental forecasting accuracy. No extrapolation from 8 mg/kg single-agent early-phase PK to the AVANZAR combination target is performed.
